captions.detailed: A tall, narrow tower-style box fan featuring a slotted front face grille running the full column height. The top of the column has a single dark rotary speed knob on a round boss stub. The entire tower is mounted on a circular base with a visible dark bearing ring, allowing the column to rotate and oscillate.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tower fan with a tall rectangular column, a slotted front grille, a top speed knob, and a circular base that allows the column to oscillate.
captions.factory: Construct the main tower column using a box primitive. Create the front grille by subtracting a series of vertical slots from a thin rectangular plate. Model the base using layered cylinders, including a dark torus or cylinder for the bearing ring, and attach a small cylinder at the top of the tower to serve as the control knob. Define a revolute articulation joint between the base and the column to enable oscillation.
